body: This PR uses the NaN-aware regridding feature of the main branch of ClimaAnalysis for the postprocessing pipeline to properly regrid along the coastlines. New functionality in ClimaAnalysis also simplifies how masks are handled in the postprocessing pipeline. I asked a LLM to implement the functionality and I reviewed the changes. title: Use NaN-aware regridding in postprocessing
